decision.rationale: Setup is complete in one cycle and stayed in scope: the only commit outside traces is its setup record. New releases (Guava 31.1, Beam's vendored Guava 32.1.2, fastutil 8.5.15) are verified 16/16 by checksum and signature, with sources pinned to their tags. Every named class is extracted and hashed, with the JDK Arrays and Lang ArrayUtils digests matching the brief. The pinned tools still match their records, and the trusted-kernel checker built at this head is byte-identical to the recorded range-capable one. Every JVM count in the brief reproduced on Temurin 21.0.13. It restored the receiver campaign's Maven cache (586 files, 0 missing), which the watcher's cleanup had removed, by hard links. Freezing the checker, the historical-producer trials, the Lean work and all verifier runs are rightly left to the domain agent. Next: brief_queue.py next --finished.
